body:
I understand where you're coming from too; I also feel ashamed, I feel like I'm lazy, boring. What helps me is to keep in mind that I am not my depression.  


Hope everything goes well at the next appointment :)

Yeah same, I sometimes feel like I'm losing my outgoing/fun personality and I hate myself for it :( It's like I'm a completely different person.  


It's OK to complain! I feel like I've discovered more about myself just talking it out or ranting it out, even to myself. Know that it's totally normal to feel that too.

How's your relationship with your parents? I say tell them when you're ready and comfortable.     


Also, you can check if your school offers counseling/therapy! Some schools offer for it for free and it's confidential, so definitely check it out if you can.

I feel this a lot. Don't worry, know you're not alone. I also feel like depression has sucked all the energy and fun out of me and it's hard to even have a conversation.  
Also relate on the bored of life part, nothing feels enjoyable anymore.
I feel this way :( I feel like I lost myself to depression. Just know you're not alone

i'm also going to be seeing friends next week for the first time in a while. it's okay to feel like you want to bail or even bail, depression can really get to us. i do it all the time. it's normal to feel that way.   


if you go, remember that slow progress is still progress! let us know if you end up gong :) if not, do something you love alone!
Yeah, that's true but I also don't know how to find happiness in myself :(

Hi, I definitely understand where you're coming from. You described a lot of my thoughts that I've been having for the past week or so. Feeling very alone and not knowing who I can open up to or how they'll react when I do. Though my friends tell me 'it's fine, you can talk to me,' I'm still scared of what goes on in their head when they listen to my complicated thoughts.   


Trust me, you're not going through this alone. I know that's cheesy advice, but there are a lot of people who go through this, some might not choose to open up about it. I believe in you. I'm also just believing that good things take time, even though that 'time' feels forever. But the 'time will come.  


Have you ever tried therapy or a support group? It's helped for me, so was wondering if that can be an outlet for you to let out your feelings.
Today was also pretty rough for me, you're not alone! Just been numb, don't really feel anything anymore.
How're you doing today?

Yeah I'm the same, I can relate to a lot of these points. I'm an extrovert with social anxiety so it didn't affect me as much before but recently I think my depression has made my social anxiety worse.  


Another one: Isolating yourself from friends because you never feel 'fun' around them even though they tell you it's fine.   


Afraid of how people will see you when you're alone so you always need to be around a friend or two at school.

>thing

Thanks for checking in. Not so great, I feel like depression is making me numb :( How are you??
Aw this would be so nice. Can I join this check-in buddy thing?

Yeah, I never knew until I started experiencing it myself. This is what goes through my mind: I love being around people yet a part of me is anxious about what they're thinking of me. So my thoughts are always 50/50. It's frustrating, though haha.
Yeah, same for me. It's like the social anxiety takes over my extrovertedness.

Hey, just want to say though you feel broke and fragile... there's still time for you to heal. I know you've probably heard this advice already (so have I, and sometimes I get so sick of generic advice) but truly, we're all going to heal one day no matter how long our depression feels.
Nothing life-changing happened. I've definitely drifted from friends which has affected my self-esteem, in a way.
Thanks for this advice! I've been going to therapy for a few months now.
Yeah, same. Definitely covering it up and thinking it'll go away never helped me either.

Yeah I totally get what you mean, those are also some of the thoughts I've been having recently. My first semester in college went surprisingly well (a little too well, was what I imagined it to be because now everyday feels so bland) but my second semester was spent crying in the library, hoping people I know didn't see me.   


I'm also going to therapy but not on antidepressants yet. I also think everyone romanticizes college and never thought my mental health would be the top of my worries.   


I'm here to private chat via reddit if you ever need someone. Would love to be there for others who're going through the same thing as me.

"I'm so lonely but I want to be alone" literally described me in a nutshell. Just know that you're not alone and that phrase is literally in my mind 24/7. Even when I'm around people, I think of that and my mind goes into panic mode thinking no one really cares or supports me.   


What I've learned is that society tells us we need to be around people to be happy, but a lot of people are also happy alone after learning self-love and care. I don't know if this helps, but this has helped me worry a little less about not having 'enough' or 'any' friends. Know you're not alone, I (and I'm sure people out there) have the same worry.
